steps.description: Render the unfinished to-do count below the list in src/App.tsx

qaChecklist.condition: Below the list, the number of unfinished to-dos is shown as "N to-dos left", or "1 to-do left" for one.
The count is hidden when there are no to-dos at all.
The count updates as to-dos are added, ticked, unticked and deleted.
The count includes every unfinished to-do whichever filter is selected.
The repo's typecheck, lint and tests pass.
The diff only touches what the issue needs, with no hardcoded or test-only shortcuts.
